title: Comparative Study Between CPAP Mask and Stacked Breathing o Pneumonia
brief_summary: the study aimed to compare the effect of using NIV with using CPAP mask and stacked breathing exercise and its efficacy on chest expansion and pulmonary functions in pneumonic patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age of 18 - 60 years.
* patients of both genders.
* patients diagnosed with pneumonia.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Orthopedic conditions.
* Malignant conditions.
* Cognitive impairments.
